pr.title: Fix setting names in the npm extension README
pr.body:
The npm extension README names two settings that don't exist:

- The Settings list documents `npm.scriptCodeLens.enable`. There is no such setting in `extensions/npm/package.json`. The script code lens reads `debug.javascript.codelens.npmScripts` (`extensions/npm/src/npmScriptLens.ts:23`), which the JavaScript debugger contributes. The list now names that setting.
- "Run Scripts from a Folder in the Explorer" says the feature is enabled with `npm.runScriptFromFolder`. That's the command ID (`src/npmMain.ts`); the setting is `npm.enableRunFromFolder` (`package.json`, default `false`), which the Settings list already names correctly.

README only, no code changes. To check: search Settings for `scriptCodeLens` (no result) and `debug.javascript.codelens.npmScripts` (found).

Prepared with AI assistance (Claude Code); I reviewed the diff and checked both names against the source.

files.patch:
@@ -26,7 +26,7 @@ the hover shown on a script or using the command `Run Selected Npm Script`.
 
 ### Run Scripts from a Folder in the Explorer
 
-The extension supports running a script as a task from a folder in the Explorer. The command  `Run NPM Script in Folder...` shown in the Explorer context menu finds all scripts in `package.json` files that are contained in this folder. You can then select the script to be executed as a task from the resulting list. You enable this support with the `npm.runScriptFromFolder` which is `false` by default.
+The extension supports running a script as a task from a folder in the Explorer. The command  `Run NPM Script in Folder...` shown in the Explorer context menu finds all scripts in `package.json` files that are contained in this folder. You can then select the script to be executed as a task from the resulting list. You enable this support with the `npm.enableRunFromFolder` setting, which is `false` by default.
 
 ### Others
 
@@ -41,4 +41,4 @@ The extension fetches data from <https://registry.npmjs.org> and <https://regist
 - `npm.exclude` - Glob patterns for folders that should be excluded from automatic script detection. The pattern is matched against the **absolute path** of the package.json. For example, to exclude all test folders use '**/test/**'.
 - `npm.scriptExplorerAction` - The default click action: `open` or `run`, the default is `open`.
 - `npm.enableRunFromFolder` - Enable running npm scripts from the context menu of folders in Explorer, the default is `false`.
-- `npm.scriptCodeLens.enable` - Enable/disable the code lenses to run a script, the default is `false`.
+- `debug.javascript.codelens.npmScripts` - Where to show the code lenses to run and debug a script. This setting is contributed by the JavaScript debugger.
